name: DTS audio passthrough
description: Switches the eARC output to full-rate (HBR) passthrough for apps that play DTS-HD, TrueHD and DTS:X themselves. webOS 6 only.
about: Installs and manages the earc_route kernel module (a separate GPL-2.0 program, downloaded from its own release and checked against a fixed SHA-256) so that players such as tvlauncher or Native Jelly can send DTS-HD MA, DTS:X and TrueHD to a receiver over eARC. It does not play or decode anything itself. Only for LG TVs on webOS 6 (kernel 4.4.84), tested on an LG C1 only; other TVs are refused. Loading the module is undone by a reboot without the boot script.
